summary_hint: <association> HOA for <unit address>: dues <amount>/<frequency>, current balance <amount>, <paid-current | past due <amount>>. — the DTI-relevant headline a processor needs without opening the statement.

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: identity: who issued the statement (association or management company); source validation.

typed_core.name: association_name
typed_core.why: CO-2/DT-2: identifies the HOA (detects a condo/PUD obligation); identity. From entity.

typed_core.name: management_company
typed_core.why: processor: contact/verification party; the 'with contact info' purpose of the doc. From entity.

typed_core.name: association_contact_phone
typed_core.why: processor: dues re-verification callback. Flattened from association_contact_information.

typed_core.name: association_contact_email_or_url
typed_core.why: processor: independent verification / audit trail. Flattened from association_contact_information.

typed_core.name: association_contact_address
typed_core.why: processor: source reconciliation / where to send payment. Flattened from association_contact_information.

typed_core.name: unit_owner_name
typed_core.why: identity: whose account; match to borrower. From unit_owner_names[0].

typed_core.name: unit_owner_name_2
typed_core.why: identity: co-owner on the account. From unit_owner_names[1].

typed_core.name: property_or_unit_address
typed_core.why: CO-2/DT-2 floor: detect the condo/PUD obligation and match the statement to the subject (or another owned) property.
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the property/unit address even though this statement may be for the subject property or another property the borrower owns — do NOT decide which; matching happens downstream.

typed_core.name: owner_account_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII (restricted, pre-masked); cross-document / account matching key.

typed_core.name: regular_assessment_amount
typed_core.why: CO-2, DT-2 floor: the dues figure that must be in the DTI payment.
typed_core.prompt_hint: Report the recurring dues amount and its period separately from any account balance; do not sum them.

typed_core.name: dues_frequency
typed_core.why: CO-2, DT-2 disambiguator: $350/mo vs /qtr vs /yr materially changes DTI.

typed_core.name: next_due_date
typed_core.why: processor; disambiguator: the next payment date.

typed_core.name: collection_or_lien_status
typed_core.why: processor: an HOA lien affects title/warrantability.

typed_core.name: reserve_percentage
typed_core.why: CO-4 (reserve adequacy) — normally on the HOA budget, likely absent here.
typed_core.prompt_hint: Reserve contribution as a % of budget — usually on the HOA budget, not a dues statement; extract only if literally printed here, otherwise null.

nested_lists.name: special_assessment_items
nested_lists.shape_reason: few items (typically 0–3), each with description/amount/duration; flat is cheapest and stays well under the ceiling.

fields.name: description
fields.why: the special-assessment description behind the full-payment picture for CO-2/DT-2

fields.name: duration
fields.why: how long the special assessment runs (per-item detail for future warrantability/reserve rules)

nested_lists.name: payment_ledger
nested_lists.shape_reason: the account activity ledger (dated charge/payment rows with a running balance) — can run to dozens of rows over multiple pages, so it drives the ≥2-list budget. Captured for future payment-history/delinquency rules; no live consumer yet (LP-460).

fields.name: charge
fields.why: the charge amount on the row

fields.name: paid
fields.why: the payment amount on the row

fields.name: running_balance
fields.why: the running balance after the row (NOT the scalar balance)

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: not a standardized form; classification handles type

rejected.name: effective_date, expiration_date, statement_period_start, statement_period_end
rejected.reason: duplicate statement_date; a dues statement has no coverage period that a rule reads

rejected.name: statement_period (date_range)
rejected.reason: duplicates statement_date + dues_frequency; no coercer for date_range

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: redundant — owners named via unit_owner_names; association via its own fields

rejected.name: loan_number, account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not on an HOA statement; account key captured via owner_account_number_masked

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block, document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: an HOA dues statement is not executed/notarized

rejected.name: payments_and_credits
rejected.reason: ledger detail; no consumer (one-list budget spent on special assessments)

encoding_variations: Dues frequency: 'Monthly Dues', 'Quarterly Assessment', '$4,200/yr' — dues_frequency must travel beside regular_assessment_amount, or the DTI payment is computed on the wrong period.

Issuer identity: the statement may be issued by the association directly or by its management company; issuer_name, association_name, and management_company are kept separately so a management-company header is not mistaken for the HOA.
Balance vs dues: the recurring assessment (regular_assessment_amount) is distinct from the ledger current_balance/past_due_amount; only the recurring dues feed DTI.
Paid-current / lien status: stated as a checkbox, 'Account in good standing', 'In collections', or a lien reference — reported as text.

open_questions.q: CO-4 reserve percentage is not on this document. CO-4's required docs are the HOA budget and condo questionnaire; a dues statement rarely prints a reserve %.
options: keep reserve_percentage as a best-effort typed field
remove it here and route CO-4 entirely to the HOA-budget schema
open_questions.recommendation: route CO-4 to the HOA-budget schema; keep the field here only opportunistically. GEET'S DECISION (LP-439): route CO-4 to the HOA-budget schema; keep the reserve field here opportunistically.

open_questions.q: special_assessment_items shape/count. Item count is uncertain (0–3 typical, occasionally more).
open_questions.recommendation: flat-row nested (preserves per-item description/duration for future warrantability rules). GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.
str + a prompt hint rather than a validated enum until values are confirmed.

open_questions.q: Issuer overlap. issuer_name vs association_name vs management_company can collide.
open_questions.recommendation: keep all three and let the disambiguation live in the snippets.

open_questions.q: owner_account_number_masked registration. New PII key distinct from account_number_masked.
options: raw handling if HOAs print it in full
open_questions.recommendation: register as pre_masked=true; confirm HOAs actually mask it (some print it in full → would need raw handling). GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

notes: The CO-2/DT-2 floor (regular_assessment_amount, dues_frequency, property_or_unit_address) is already served by the existing schema.

PII: owner_account_number_masked needs _PII_FIELDS registration (pre_masked true), a distinct key from the existing account_number_masked; without registration a captured account number lands raw in the catch-all. unit_owner_name/_2 and property_or_unit_address are standard/property values kept typed for matching, not registered.
Do not judge whether dues are 'in the payment' — report the dues; CO-2/DT-2 judge.
reserve_percentage is a rule-floor field for CO-4 but likely absent on a dues statement; Open Q1 recommends routing CO-4 to the HOA-budget schema and keeping this field only opportunistically.
